protocol: value_anchoring_v1: Block-10 minimal experiment. Options have different internal outcome probabilities (P(good)); value_anchor learns per-option value from experience (auditable: read back each option's estimate) and prefers the best; uniform and fixed controls. Criterion: value_anchor ordering accuracy >= 0.9 and ends on the best option more than uniform/fixed by >= 0.2 -- preferences form from internal signals, not injected rewards.
